primitives.summary: The only public Convex builders: adminQuery, adminMutation and adminAction run requireAdmin against the Better Auth session and the single ADMIN_EMAIL allowlist before the handler, and expose the operator as ctx.admin. The Pages dashboard gate (apps/site/src/dashboard-access.ts) applies the same allowlist before serving the dashboard shell.

guarantees.statement: Every Convex module is .ts and none imports or re-exports a public builder (query, mutation, action, their Generic forms, or httpAction outside http.ts) except lib/functions.ts, whose builders keep the closed requireAdmin form. The TypeScript checker classifies every export of every module (nested, aliased, re-exported) and a public function or HTTP action must be a const declared by an adminQuery/adminMutation/adminAction call; any or unknown exports are rejected. Evaluated once per AOHYS_ENV as a Convex push would, every export that is public at runtime must be one of those admin registrations, and a call through its Convex entry point, anonymous or signed in outside ADMIN_EMAIL, must be refused by requireAdmin with the matching error before any other syscall or network call; the evaluation gets no provider credentials and "use node" modules export only internal functions. Scope: mistakes and copied patterns; code written to defeat the guard is left to review.
guarantees.verifiedBy: pnpm architecture:fitness (scripts/architecture/public-function-guard.mjs), run by the pre-push hook whenever apps/, functions/, packages/ or scripts/ change and by pnpm run verify:ci
